Relax 人人都是产品经理 constraint: no longer require homepage right-side recommendation module; use homepage-confirmable recommendation-related content instead.
Remove web_search fallback; use web_fetch only when agent-browser fails. Tighten fallback policy wording.

Require visible browser interaction and stricter woshipm recommendation extraction
Require agent-browser first, check installation availability, and only fall back to web search/fetch after agent-browser failure.
Enforce real article links by default, add strict output validation and explicit downgrade rules when links or target sections cannot be confirmed.
